items.paraphrase: Walking distance to a direct stair is 30 m generally, raised to 50 m where main structure is fire-resistant or noncombustible; 40 m on floors 16+ of tall apartments.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in English text at the KLRI page; the 40 m case applies to 16+ storey apartments.

items.paraphrase: Offices of fire-resistant or noncombustible structure use the same 50 m limit.
Floors up to the 10th storey are divided into compartments of 1000 m2 each.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via www.law.go.kr (official text). Applies to floors 10 and below; 11th floor and above use 200 m2 (500 m2 with noncombustible finishes). Decree Art. 46 trigger read earlier at KLRI.

items.paraphrase: With sprinklers or similar automatic extinguishing, floors up to the 10th storey allow 3000 m2 per compartment.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via www.law.go.kr (official text). 11th floor and above: 600 m2 (1500 m2 with noncombustible finishes).

items.paraphrase: Ceiling of a habitable room is at least 2.1 m, counting beams or the slab underside where no ceiling exists.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via www.law.go.kr (official text). Rule Art. 16 implements decree Art. 50; assembly/religious halls over 200 m2 need 4 m (2.7 m under balconies). Housing standard 2.2 m not re-read.

items.paraphrase: Same 2.1 m ceiling rule applies to offices, which are not in the exempted use list.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via www.law.go.kr (official text). Decree Art. 50 exempts only factories, warehouses, hazardous storage, animal/plant and recycling facilities and graveyards, so offices are covered.

items.paraphrase: Window area for daylight in a habitable room is at least one tenth of that room's floor area.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via www.law.go.kr (official text). Exempt where lighting of the table-set illuminance is installed; ventilation openings 1/20 (Art. 17(2)).

items.paraphrase: Common stairs have a clear width of at least 120 cm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via www.law.go.kr (official text). Table is an image on law.go.kr; read the image. Outdoor stairs row: 90 cm / 20 cm / 24 cm.

items.paraphrase: Common stairs have a riser of at most 18 cm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via www.law.go.kr (official text). Table is an image on law.go.kr; read the image. Outdoor stairs row: 90 cm / 20 cm / 24 cm.

items.paraphrase: Common stairs have a tread of at least 26 cm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via www.law.go.kr (official text). Table is an image on law.go.kr; read the image. Outdoor stairs row: 90 cm / 20 cm / 24 cm.

items.paraphrase: Housing estates need at least one space per dwelling, 0.7 for dwellings of 60 m2 exclusive area or less.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via www.law.go.kr (official text). National minimum 1 space per dwelling, 0.7 where exclusive area is 60 m2 or less; area-based ratios also apply; local ordinances may tighten (up to +20%).

items.paraphrase: Accessible corridor clear width is at least 1.2 m, and 1.5 m may be used with rooms on both sides.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via www.law.go.kr (official text). Read in the annex PDF rendered as image; 1.5 m allowed where rooms line both sides.

items.paraphrase: Accessible entrance doors need at least 0.9 m clear passage width.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via www.law.go.kr (official text). Clear passage width of accessible entrance doors; 1.2 m clear zone in front of the door.

items.paraphrase: Wheelchair turning space is a 150 cm circle.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: law.go.kr annex 1 PDF (flSeq=135226913); a 1.5 m square for rotation is given, no circle diameter, so kept unverified as a proxy

items.paraphrase: Accessible ramp slope is at most 1:12.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via www.law.go.kr (official text). Up to 1:8 only for existing buildings, height under 1 m, with staff assistance.
